title: Paint-Anything: Unified Any-Color Control for Image Generation and Editing
why_read: An image generation/editing method that lets users specify exact hex colors for objects, addressing a real gap in current diffusion model controllability.
analysis: Paint-Anything tackles a practical design problem: existing image generation and editing models struggle to hit a precise, specified hex color for a particular object rather than just an approximate color family. The approach trains models to associate hex codes with color semantics using a large curated dataset of real images plus synthetic pure-color anchors to handle cases where shadows distort real-world color labels. Tested on FLUX.2-4B, it substantially improves benchmark scores for both text-to-image generation and editing color fidelity. This is a fairly narrow but practically useful contribution for designers and any pipeline needing exact brand or product colors in generated imagery.
